rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a pub or bar.

example.english: We're going to the pub tonight to watch the football match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 zau2 baa1 tai2 bo1

rows.note: Use this for a tavern-like or more traditional pub rather than the usual modern bar.

example.english: That tavern-like pub has a great atmosphere and live music.
example.traditional: 嗰間酒館好有風味，仲有現場音樂。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 gun2 hou2 jau5 fung1 mei6 zung6 jau5 jin6 coeng4 jam1 ngok6
